headword: {柔軟体操|じゅうなんたいそう}

definitions.gloss: stretching exercises; flexibility exercises; calisthenics for flexibility
definitions.explanation: Physical exercises designed to increase the body's flexibility and range of motion, typically involving bending, reaching, and holding stretched positions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{柔軟体操|じゅうなんたいそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I do stretching exercises every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{柔軟体操|じゅうなんたいそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ほぐしましょう→ほぐす：10496_hogusu⟧。
examples.english: Let's loosen up with stretching exercises before working out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{硬|かた}く→硬い：01116_katai⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧がちだ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{柔軟体操|じゅうなんたいそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{続|つづ}ければ{怪我|けが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予防|よぼう}→予防：03669_yobou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: As you age, your body tends to become stiff, but continuing stretching exercises every day can also help prevent injuries.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{柔軟|じゅうなん}→柔軟：13101_juunan⟧ (flexible, supple) and ⟦{体操|たいそう}→体操：04493_taisou⟧ (gymnastics, exercises). This is the traditional Japanese term for stretching exercises. While the English loanword ⟦ストレッチ→ストレッチ：05239_sutorecchi⟧ is now widely used, {柔軟体操|じゅうなんたいそう} remains common in school PE classes and among older generations.

In Japanese schools, students typically do {柔軟体操|じゅうなんたいそう} as part of ⟦{体育|たいいく}→体育：03384_taiiku⟧ (physical education). Flexibility is often tested in fitness assessments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {柔軟体操|じゅうなんたいそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do stretching exercises
- {柔軟体操|じゅうなんたいそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ほぐす→ほぐす：10496_hogusu⟧: to loosen up the body with stretching
- {柔軟体操|じゅうなんたいそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to keep up stretching exercises

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ストレッチ→ストレッチ：05239_sutorecchi⟧: stretching — the modern loanword, now more common in gyms and fitness contexts
- ⟦{準備運動|じゅんびうんどう}→準備運動：14909_junbiundou⟧: warm-up exercises — broader term including light jogging and other warm-up activities, not just stretching
- ⟦{体操|たいそう}→体操：04493_taisou⟧: gymnastics; exercises — the general term for physical exercises and calisthenics
- ⟦ヨガ→ヨガ：04737_yoga⟧: yoga — includes stretching but also breathing and meditation
